Name: Zc_Trainer_Example
$Comment: The library's sample trainer's conversation, which its placement (NpcPlacements/Zc_Trainer_Example.json) opens on press F: one line and two answers. Train opens the trainer page through the Trainer destination ({ "Open": "Trainer" }), which names no placement, so it opens the trainer the player is talking to. Any conversation gives a trainer its Train answer the same way.
